messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 5xx rate detected for requests originating in EU that are being routed to apac-east egress (service: api-proxy). 5xx rate 12% -> 38% in 3m. Alerting on-call.

tim_oncall: on it. seeing 502/503, some 504s. paging net team @maya_net. any recent routing/policy changes?

maya_net: I pushed a geo-routing policy rollout 11:05 UTC that shards region egress by ASN to improve locality. rollout id: geo-rollout-2026-03-15-6. I only updated apac shard rules but the promotion job touched the global route-table entries (suspect).

aj_sre: grabbing traces. can you paste a sample traceroute / tcpdump from one of the failing egress hosts?

maya_net: paste sample below from eu-front-03 -> observed path suddenly going via as64500 then blackholing:

```
$ traceroute -n 10.0.14.23
traceroute to 34.210.xx.xx (34.210.xx.xx), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.14.1  0.2 ms  0.1 ms  0.1 ms
 2  100.64.0.5  1.1 ms  1.0 ms  1.0 ms
 3  203.0.113.5  12.5 ms  12.4 ms  12.3 ms
 4  * * *
 5  * * *
```

maya_net: tcpdump shows RST/ICMP unreachable from next-hop after policy applied.

tim_oncall: ok. initial theory: rollout misapplied global route update; EU requests got pinned to apac egress AS and then dropped.

sophia_support: customer impact: several EU tenants report request failures, top 5 affected accounts: acct-103, acct-221, acct-777 (payment flow failures reported), monitoring shows spike in error-rate for checkout API. CX on call.

aj_sre: agree revert is safest. can we rollback the rollout to previous route-table snapshot? @deploy-bot please?

deploy-bot: Received rollback request for geo-rollout-2026-03-15-6. Starting rollback to snapshot geo-snapshot-2026-03-15-5. Steps: 1) disable promotion 2) reapply previous global route entries 3) sanity checks. ETA ~ 90s.

tim_oncall: enabling verbose tracing on eu-front nodes and increasing health-check frequency to 5s. also adding temporary rule to prefer local-eu egress for eu origins as emergency patch.

maya_net: rollback step 1/3 done (promotion disabled).

deploy-bot: rollback step 2/3 done (global route entries reverted).

aj_sre: rolling health-checks show backend connectivity restored on 4/6 eu-front hosts. continuing.

deploy-bot: rollback step 3/3 done. Sanity checks: route convergence complete, no blackhole detected on sampled hosts.

tim_oncall: :white_check_mark: 5xx rate dropping from 38% -> 6% in last 2m. EU checkout errors trending down.

sophia_support: sending SEV update to affected customers: initial mitigation applied, root cause under investigation, expected full recovery within 10-15m.

oliver_pm: please confirm whether any feature flags or scheduled promotions were active that might have caused global touch. Need RCA input for incident report.

maya_net: preliminary: the promotion job that stages per-shard changes also runs a global sync step when new route-table digests differ. I missed a guard in the job that should have prevented global table touch for apac-only changes. filing PR to add guard.

aj_sre: collecting additional logs + diffs: route-table diff shows policy-id mismatch: apac-policy-id assigned to eu shard entry for ~7 minutes. That explains the misrouting.

tim_oncall: handoff: I'm going offline for 30m, passing pager to @aj_sre. aj, can you continue postmortem draft and remediation steps?

aj_sre: taking pager. will validate rollout guard PR in staging and schedule a hotfix for deploy job. also will collate affected customer list and duration per account.

incident-bot: Incident update: Status=mitigated, severity=sev2, started=1769584321, mitigated=1769584600, oncall=tim_oncall->aj_sre.

oliver_pm: once aj has RCA draft, I'll coordinate customer comms and release notes.

maya_net: opened issue INF-2026-432: "promotion job global-sync guard missing -> misapply shard policy" with steps to reproduce and patch attached.

aj_sre: quick postmortem notes: root cause = promotion job global-sync step applied apac shard changes to global route-table due to missing guard. impact = 7 minutes of EU traffic misrouted to APAC egress and partially blackholed, causing up to 38% 5xx for some customers and payment flow failures for 3 high-impact accounts. mitigation = rollback of rollout (geo-snapshot-2026-03-15-5) and temporary emergency preference rule for EU origins. follow-ups: 1) add guard to promotion job + tests, 2) canary the rollout to 1 host per region, 3) run audit to verify no other active rollouts touched global table.

sophia_support: will track incident in support tracker and coordinate refunds/credits if required. will update customers once postmortem is ready.

tim_oncall: closing live mitigation. leaving notes in incident tracker and handoff complete. :eyes:

aj_sre: adding timestamps and metric snapshots to the incident doc. will ping when RCA PR is ready for review.

incident-bot: Thread closed (mitigated).
